description: This file contains unit tests for the SetPlaybackRate task in a media playback system, specifically testing the behavior of setting playback rate in a GStreamer pipeline, including handling of different pipeline states and sink types.

classes.name: SetPlaybackRateTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing SetPlaybackRate behavior in various pipeline states and sink configurations.

methods.name: shouldNotChangePlaybackRateIfItsAlreadySet
methods.description: Tests that if the playback rate is already set to the desired value, no change is made.

methods.name: shouldNotChangePlaybackRateIfPipelineIsNull
methods.description: Tests that if the pipeline is null, the playback rate is not changed and a pending rate is set.

methods.name: shouldNotChangePlaybackRateIfPipelineStateIsBelowPlaying
methods.description: Tests that if the pipeline state is below 'Playing', the playback rate is not changed.

methods.name: shouldSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkNull
methods.description: Tests setting playback rate when the audio sink is null, expecting a custom event to be sent.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkNull
methods.description: Tests failure to set playback rate when the event cannot be sent.

methods.name: shouldSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkOtherThanAmlhala
methods.description: Tests setting playback rate for an audio sink that is not 'amlhalasink', expecting a custom event.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetPlaybackRateAudioSinkOtherThanAmlhala
methods.description: Tests failure to set playback rate for an audio sink that is not 'amlhalasink'.

methods.name: shouldSetPlaybackRateAmlhalaAudioSink
methods.description: Tests setting playback rate for an 'amlhalasink' sink, expecting a segment event.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetPlaybackRateAmlhalaAudioSink
methods.description: Tests failure to set playback rate for an 'amlhalasink' sink when sending the segment event fails.
